_doc: 5c-2 2b relationship dials. Design: wiki Projects/Avallone-Memory-Affinity-Design.md 'Step 2b - relationship dials: DESIGN v1' + B12. Every number is a START value to tune in dev play. A fourth dial = a new block here plus its code; no table change. Reloaded when the file changes.
_cue_place_doc: standing = in the conversation-wide head (cache-friendly, gentler); situation = beside each turn (stronger). Pick in dev play.

trust._doc: From KARMA (-15000..15000). Each NPC (stable hash of its id): the karma T above which it starts to trust (trust grows over width W); below T it treats you as a stranger (0); NEGATIVE karma brings distrust over width W_neg. Leaning -1 (inverted: the bad are trusted, the good mistrusted) for this share.

respect._doc: From FAME (0..15000). Each NPC: the fame T above which it starts to respect you (over width W); below it, 'takes you as it finds you' (0). Inverted share: the cynic who sneers at the famous. Public-deed stories about this player that reached the NPC's town add deed_each, at most deed_cap, while the story lives.

unease._doc: Town unease u in 0..1 from stories that really reached the town (exposure). + unsettling, - reassuring; each story fades linearly over its own lifetime; repeats of one character + kind within repeat_window_h count x repeat_mult (then 0). Comic kinds are 0. gm_planted: the story's own 'unease' fact (-1..1) once the GM command can set it; absent = 0.

ambience._doc: Game hour at the NPC ('now', not a clock). Night = hour >= night[0] or < night[1]. The moons matter only to superstitious NPCs (see moons).

moons._doc: the owner, chat, 2026-11-02: two moons, both on real time. glow = brightness of the real moon x brightness of an 18 h moon, each 0 (new).. 1 (full). Each superstitious NPC has its own line on the glow (from `line`, softness from `width`); above it they are spooked - trust down, up to spooked_trust. real_new_epoch = a real new moon, 2000-01-06 18:14 UTC; fast_new_epoch is arbitrary.

warmth._doc: Rest point + daily contributions fading on the memory clock (half_life_mh memory hours). Only rows that carry the memory clock (2b on) count; older visits count for familiarity only.

gift._doc: An accepted gift (the shard allows one per NPC + character + day): base x (liked, or by tip size) / (1 + gifts in the previous recent_mh memory hours), fading like the rest.

personas._doc: Named NPC overrides (persona_key): warmth_rest, superstitious, trust_T/trust_W/trust_lean, respect_T/respect_W/respect_lean.

warmth: you are deeply hostile to them because of their conduct - stay within the house rules and give normal service
you are cool towards them: be brief and businesslike
you feel nothing much either way about them
you are fond of them: be warm and glad to see them
trust: you do not trust them at all: keep your own affairs and any gossip to yourself and take nothing they claim on faith
you are wary of them: say little about yourself or anyone else
you trust them no more than any stranger
you trust them: you may speak a little more freely
you trust them completely: speak openly
respect: you think little of them and it shows
you are not impressed by them
you take them as you find them
you hold them in high regard: treat them with some deference
familiarity: they are a stranger to you
you have seen them once or twice

gossip._doc: Enforced in code: trust below trust_below -> no live gossip (asked or volunteered); warmth below greet_warmth_below -> no gossip volunteered on a greeting; familiarity (visit days) below greet_familiarity_min -> no gossip volunteered on a greeting (the owner, 2026-11-02). Held = ALL news kept back: live deeds, made-up chatter and the Rumours/ lore pages.
